note: Both sets contain the same misread profile label "L300X14" (the text layer reads L3X3X1/4) and an invented length quote "12' 2 5/8"" that appears nowhere on the page, but Set A repeats that invention for both modules while Set B makes it once. Set A correctly binds L3X3X1/4 to both the Module A and Module B PV structural members with the North/South condition and captures both overall detail lengths (12'-3 3/4" and 10'-3 3/4"), whereas Set B misbinds 10'-3 3/4" (a Module B/C1 dimension) to Module A and omits 12'-3 3/4" entirely. Set A's clear error is assigning 7'-0" (a Module A dimension) to Module B, and both sets pad with vague "component/dimension" claims, but Set A's correct, well-conditioned claims are the more informative ones.
